items.title: 【開催レポート】Sakana AIシンポジウム：Jürgen Schmidhuberが語るAIのこれまでとこれから、日本から挑む言語モデル・世界モデル・Physical AI
items.reason_zh: 官方活动回顾和研究方向公告，讲述模型预训练、世界模型和科研自动化；不是新 Harness 方法或专项评测，不计 HF 当日论文。

source_quotes.quote: On October 26, 2026, Sakana AI hosted the symposium “From World Models to Real-World AI” at Hitotsubashi Hall in Tokyo.
At the symposium, Sakana AI announced that it is moving into pre-training its own models.
This report presents the talks and the conversation as edited transcripts (excerpted, with some passages reordered for readability).
